attributes.has_name: Infrared sensor measurement drift due to thermal ageing
attributes.malfunction_description: Thermal ageing shifts the infrared sensor response or calibration so reported measurements become biased while remaining superficially plausible

attributes.has_name: LiDAR output interruption due to power supply fluctuations
attributes.malfunction_description: Under-voltage, ripple, or intermittent internal supply causes missing, corrupted, or repeatedly restarting LiDAR output

attributes.has_name: Camera sensing degradation due to temperature-related drift
attributes.malfunction_description: Ageing and repeated temperature cycling reduce camera sensor sensitivity, dynamic range, or calibration accuracy, causing objects to be missed or represented with degraded quality while the camera remains active

attributes.has_name: Perception compute unit processor / memory defect
attributes.malfunction_description: A processor execution fault or memory/state corruption produces incorrect intermediate results, corrupts object classification, or halts the detection pipeline
The PerceptionSystem no longer correctly recognizes objects — tigers within D_detection_range are missed or misclassified. Rolls up sensing, supply, and compute-unit faults to the subsystem level.
